subject: mathematics

resources.title: Contemporary Mathematics
resources.notes: OpenStax presents this as an introductory college mathematics text and its published scope includes logic, sets, probability, statistics, counting, voting and graph theory. Foundation and beginner labels are relative to these subsubjects, not a claim that all material is pre-college.

resources.title: Precalculus
resources.notes: Sequential instructional collection covering the prerequisite functions, trigonometry and analytic skills used to begin calculus.

resources.title: Differential Calculus
resources.notes: Introductory differential-calculus learning path beginning with limits and derivatives; foundation means entry into calculus, not elementary arithmetic.

resources.title: Linear Algebra
resources.notes: Entry-level linear-algebra sequence covering vectors, matrices, transformations and related foundations.

resources.title: Statistics and Probability
resources.notes: Starts with study design, data description and elementary probability before progressing to inference.

resources.title: Differential Equations
resources.notes: Introductory differential-equations sequence; beginner is relative to the subsubject and assumes prior calculus.
